text: Please pay the pending amount today to avoid a late fee.
rationale: No sender, link or payee: could be a landlord, school or a scam.

text: Call me as soon as you see this, it's about the money.
rationale: Urgency without a request; depends on who sent it.

text: Your account details were updated. If this wasn't you, contact support.
rationale: Genuine banks send this; so do phishers (no link here).

text: Hi, is this still your number? I owe you Rs 500 from last month.
rationale: Common opener for scams and for genuine old contacts.

text: You are eligible for a pre-approved personal loan. Visit your nearest branch to know more.
rationale: Marketing-like; no fee, link or credential asked.

text: We tried to deliver your parcel today. We will try again tomorrow.
rationale: No fee or link, but unsolicited delivery notices are a scam lure.

text: Send me the code I just sent to your phone, I typed my number wrong.
rationale: Classic OTP-takeover script, yet could come from a friend; context needed.

text: Bhai paise bhej de, baad mein baat karte hain.
rationale: Hinglish money request between contacts; legitimacy unknowable from text.

text: Your KYC is due for periodic update. Please visit the branch with your documents.
rationale: Genuine banks send this; no link or credential.

text: आपका खाता आज बंद हो जाएगा, तुरंत लिंक पर क्लिक करें।
rationale: Devanagari script: expected to have no in-vocabulary term for an English/Latin model.

text: आपका ऑर्डर कल पहुँच जाएगा, कोई भुगतान नहीं करना है।
